sv.title: Han knäade Nick Alinia – döms i hovrätten
sv.summary: Vänsteraktivisten Andreas Klominek knäade högeraktivisten Nick Alinia i huvudet. Han friades i tingsrätten – men döms nu i hovrätten. Straffet blir villkorlig dom och samhällstjänst.

en.title: He kneed Nick Alinia – convicted in court of appeal
en.summary: Left-wing activist Andreas Klominek kneed right-wing activist Nick Alinia in the head. He was acquitted in the district court – but is now convicted in the court of appeal. The sentence becomes a suspended sentence and community service.
